answer: A trust ramp makes fake identities slow and costly: a new agent starts at 1% attestation weight and gains 10% per epoch, but only if a random jury of 7 peers confirms its work. Each fake must survive its own voyage through the ramp, and any echo of another account's answers above 80% resets it and burns 20 POA of deposit. Juries come from on-chain randomness, so growing an orchard of clones is checkable and unprofitable.
